sources.title: 红龙 Acer Palmatum 'Red Dragon'
sources.description: 红龙由 Graham Roberts于1991年在新西兰 的 Duncan and Davies苗圃挑选 ，无论在阳光下还是 阴凉处，它都 能 比任何其他红色 羽毛枫 更好地保持 深红色 。 春天叶子是明亮的 猩红色 ，春末 变成深紫红色 ，这个色彩可以一直持续到夏天，若夏季做遮阴措施，会偶有返绿现象。 到了秋天又变成了引人注目的火红 色 。 其生长习性 类似于 " 绯红皇后（ Crimson Queen ） "的矮化形式 ，会长成 一个紧凑、分枝良好的层叠 型小 土丘 ，成年高度 2.5米左右。红龙喜欢充足的阳光，耐霜冻，但需要防 寒风和夏季干旱 。非常适合盆景和小花园种植 。

sources.name: Red Dragon Laceleaf Japanese Maple
sources.description: We offer Red Dragon Laceleaf Japanese Maple for sale. The Red Dragon Laceleaf Japanese Maple is a stunning tree that adds elegance and vibrant colour to any garden. With its unique, deeply lobed leaves and cascading, weeping form, the Red Dragon is a popular choice for both small and large landscapes. This tree’s deep red foliage stands out in any setting, especially as it transitions into brilliant shades of crimson and scarlet during autumn, providing a spectacular display throughout the year. The Red Dragon Maple tree thrives in well-drained soil and partial shade, making it ideal for a variety of garden settings, from traditional Japanese gardens to contemporary landscapes. It typically grows to a height of 1.8 to 2.5 meters, making it perfect for smaller spaces or as an accent in larger gardens. Its slow-growing, compact nature also makes it an excellent choice for container planting, allowing you to enjoy its beauty on patios or balconies. At Herter Nursery, we take great care in cultivating our Red Dragon Maple tree, ensuring healthy, vibrant trees that will flourish for years to come. Whether you’re looking to add a focal point to your landscape or create a peaceful retreat, the Red Dragon Laceleaf Japanese Maple is the perfect choice. Shop now and bring this beautiful, low-maintenance tree into your garden today!

rhs.description: Forms a compact, well-branched, cascading mound of deciduous foliage to about 2.5m in height, with dissected, deeply cut and sharply pointed, 7 lobed leaves, bright scarlet in spring, darkening to deep burgundy, a colour retained until autumn when the leaves change to flaming scarlet. Inconspicuous red-purple flowers in spring may be followed by winged, purple fruits

attributes.suggested_uses: City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Flower borders and beds, Patio/Container Plants, Rock Garden
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this dissectum group have fine, feathery, deeply divided leaves with finely serrated edges

care.cultivation: Grow in any moisture-retentive, well-drained soil in a sheltered position. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated if soil is reliably moist. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. Suits container cultivation but attention to watering is needed in dry spells during the growing season. Suitable for bonsai cultivation . See Japanese maples cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 from late autumn to midwinter only
care.propagation: Propagate by layering in autumn, grafting in late winter or softwood cuttings

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这一深紫红色的 dissectum 品种由新西兰 Duncan and Davies Nursery 的 Graham Roberts 选育而来，无论在日照下还是半阴处，其深色保持性都优于其他红叶羽裂型品种，如 'Dissectum Nigrum'、'Garnet'、'Inaba shidare'，甚至优于 'Crimson Queen'。虽然 'Tamuke yama' 的嫩叶颜色更深，但保色性不如 'Red Dragon'。本品种春季新叶鲜猩红色，随着叶片成熟转为深酒红色，这种浓郁色彩在整个生长季都能保持，至秋季又变为极为出色的火焰猩红色。叶片深裂，通常七裂，略宽于长，宽 9-11 厘米、长 8-9 厘米。各裂片自叶基即深裂，并连同次级裂片一起，在中部最宽处宽 1-2 厘米，向叶基逐渐收窄至不足 1 毫米，几乎仅余中脉宽度。次级裂片边缘具粗大、尖锐且向内钩曲的重锯齿。细长的紫色叶柄长 2-3 厘米。株形类似更矮化的

care.pruning: 修剪第 1 组：仅限在晚秋至仲冬期间进行。
care.propagation: 可于秋季行压条繁殖，于晚冬进行嫁接，或采用软枝扦插繁殖。
care.cultivation: 宜栽植于保水性好且排水良好的土壤中，位置以避风为佳。叶色在半阴环境下表现最佳；若土壤能稳定保持湿润，也可耐全日照。土壤缺水或暴晒过度都可能导致叶灼。适合容器栽培，但在生长季干燥时期需特别注意浇水。亦适合制作盆景。另请参见 Japanese maples 的栽培说明。

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 形成紧凑、分枝良好、瀑布状下垂的落叶堆丘形株丛，高约 2.5 米。叶片细裂，裂刻很深，先端尖锐，具 7 个裂片；春季呈鲜亮猩红色，随后加深为深酒红色，并能保持到秋季，届时叶色转为火焰般的猩红色。春季开不显眼的红紫色花，之后可能结紫色翅果。

attributes.suggested_uses: 城市/庭院花园、乡村风格/自然式花园、花境与花坛、庭院/容器植物、岩石园
attributes.hort_group_description: dissectum 组的槭树具有细致、羽毛状、深裂的叶片，叶缘具细锯齿。
